verdict.rationale: Gusto provides a separate sandbox environment: the official CLI has distinct `--env sandbox` (api.gusto-demo.com) and `--env production` (api.gusto.com) targets with separate credential slots, plus `--dry-run` to preview create requests. The docs also say demo companies are auto-generated with company info, employees, and prior payrolls so you can start testing right away, which keeps test work off production data. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party sandbox guide (account provisioning, data isolation guarantees, parity with production behaviour such as simulated payroll processing and webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
